suppress.notes: False CPE match: CVE-2026-53914 is unsafe deserialization of the Kotlin compiler's build cache metadata. kotlin-stdlib (with its jdk7/jdk8 parts) and kotlin-reflect are only runtime libraries that okhttp (JDA, Slack Bolt) and the Spring AI OpenAI starter need; the project does not compile Kotlin, so no build cache is read. Spring Boot 4.1 (4.1.2) still manages kotlin.version 2.3.21; the fix is in Kotlin 2.4.20.
